quyet-1-2-large.author: Chinh Nguyen (chinhnc on Hugging Face)

cost.basis: GPU-time estimate from v1.8.0: one monthly-rented RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, USD 1.5235/hour; average load 70%. Architecture: dense gemma, 31B active parameters; throughput 10106.516129 tokens/s (architecture-class calibration, efficient-engine prefill). GPU-time cost USD 0.018859030495733/1,000; old list-price estimate USD 0.0283740564137005/1,000 (google/gemma-4-31b-it at USD 0.09/M input and USD 0.34/M output). Applied min(old list-price estimate, GPU-time cost) = USD 0.018859030495733/1,000. Estimated, not a bill.

quyet-1-2-large.disclosure: Paid public evaluation. Measured on the 27 Oct draw on an evaluator-owned Verda GPU VM (RTXPRO6000), offline with the author's serving stack at the pinned commit. Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers. Successor of Quyet-1.0-Large (measured on the v1.5 draw); no comparison is drawn between the two draws. Decision model: Gemma 4 31B with fully merged weights and a separate option head; choice via the option head, score and noul via vocabulary-symbol scores with fixed per-type temperatures; 0 output tokens.
